model_annotation: The plot illustrates the training rewards across different steps for two training sets, easy and hard. The x-axis, representing steps, has a linear scale with a range of 0 to 500, and tick labels are regularly spaced at intervals of 100, with units of steps. The y-axis, representing training rewards, has a linear scale with a range of 0 to 0.4 for the easy training set and 0 to 0.2 for the hard training set; tick labels are regularly spaced at intervals of 0.1 and 0.05 respectively. For the easy training set plot, there are two lines: one is blue, with a solid line style and no markers, representing Llama-On-Policy-Easy, and starts near 0.05 and ends near 0.15; the other is red, with a solid line style and no markers, representing Llama-LUFFY-Easy, and starts near 0.05 and ends near 0.15. For the hard training set plot, the blue line, representing Llama-On-Policy-Hard, starts near 0.05 and ends near 0, and the red line, representing Llama-LUFFY-Hard, starts near 0 and ends near 0.05.
